ticks.note: Tick 1 enters S. Its only transition is a delayed self-loop, so nothing is computed yet and every output still has its initial value.
int / int is integer division: q = 3, r = 1. f = A / B is also 3: the division happens in int before the result is stored in the float.
Division truncates towards zero and the remainder takes the sign of the dividend (as in C): q = -3, r = -1.
